error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动发生错误!
error_list.chinese_solution: 尝试重启或请联系制造商!
error_list.english_solution: Try restarting or contact the manufacturer.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动过压!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电池参数,回馈电流及电池连接;确保再生制动回路正常!
error_list.english_solution: Check battery parameters, regen current and connections; ensure regenerative brake circuit is normal.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动欠压!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电池,保险丝,主接触器及参数;确认电缆,端子紧固!
error_list.english_solution: Inspect battery, fuses, main contactor and parameters; verify cables and terminals are tight.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动预充电错误!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查主接触器,B+ 线路及电容电压;确认预充电阻,电容完
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Pre-charge Error!
error_list.english_solution: Check main contactor, B+ line and capacitor voltage; confirm pre-charge resistor and capacitor are intact.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动过载/电流传感器故障!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电机相线是否短路,电流传感器及其供电;重新标定电流环
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Over-current / Current Sensor Fault!
error_list.english_solution: Check motor phase short, current sensor and its supply; recalibrate the current loop.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动控制器温度异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 降低负载或改善散热;确认散热片,风扇,环境温度正常!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Controller Temperature Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Reduce load or improve cooling; verify heatsink, fan and ambient temperature are normal.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动电机温度异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电机温升,散热条件,热敏电阻;必要时停机冷却!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Motor Temperature Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check motor temperature rise, cooling conditions and thermistor; shut down for cooling if necessary.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动因温度降功率!
error_list.chinese_solution: 继续降功率运行或停机降温;检查散热/负载!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Power Derated due to Temperature!
error_list.english_solution: Continue derated operation or shut down to cool; inspect cooling and load.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动电机开路!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电机 U/V/W 相线连接;确认绕组,端子无断线!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Motor Open Circuit!
error_list.english_solution: Check motor U/V/W phase connections; confirm windings and terminals are not open.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动电机短路!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电机绕组,相线是否短路;排除外部短路点!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Motor Short Circuit!
error_list.english_solution: Check motor windings and phase short circuits; eliminate external short points.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动堵转/速度异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电机是否卡滞,编码器及负载;重新标定速度/负载参数!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Motor Stall / Speed Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check motor jam, encoder and load; recalibrate speed/load parameters.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动电机类型/相位/极性错误!
error_list.chinese_solution: 重新进行电机自学习;核对电机铭牌,极性,相序!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Motor Type / Phase / Polarity Error!
error_list.english_solution: Re-run motor auto-tuning; verify nameplate, polarity and phase sequence.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动编码器信号丢失!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查编码器供电,接线,屏蔽;确认编码器完好!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Encoder Signal Lost!
error_list.english_solution: Check encoder supply, wiring and shielding; confirm encoder is intact.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动编码器反馈异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查编码器信号,连线,屏蔽;必要时更换编码器!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Encoder Feedback Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check encoder signal, wiring and shielding; replace encoder if necessary.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动消息/PDO超时!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查 CAN 网络连接,波特率,PDO 配置;确认电缆屏
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Message / PDO Timeout!
error_list.english_solution: Check CAN network connections, baud rate and PDO configuration; confirm cable shielding.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动通信总线异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查总线终端电阻,电缆,接头;排除干扰源!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Communication Bus Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check bus termination resistors, cables and connectors; eliminate interference sources.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动消息校验错误!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查 CAN 电缆,屏蔽,终端电阻;确认节点无故障!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Message Check Error!
error_list.english_solution: Check CAN cables, shielding and termination resistors; ensure nodes are fault-free.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动通信映射错误!
error_list.chinese_solution: 核对 PDO 映射表,节点 ID,报文格式;重新下载映射
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Communication Mapping Error!
error_list.english_solution: Verify PDO mapping, node ID and message format; reload mapping configuration.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动油门/模拟输入/原点/限位信号异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查油门,限位开关,原点开关及其接线;确认信号范围及参数
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Throttle / Analog / Home / Limit Signal Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Inspect throttle, limit and home switches and wiring; confirm signal range and parameters.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动制动信号/保护/STO信号异常!

error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Brake / Protection / STO Signal Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check brake switch, STO circuit and wiring; confirm safety chain is normal.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动模拟量超限!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查模拟量输入上下限,接线,屏蔽;重新标定!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Analog Input Out of Range!
error_list.english_solution: Check analog input limits, wiring and shielding; recalibrate.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动接触器/继电器故障!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查接触器线圈,触点,保险丝;必要时更换接触器!
error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Contactor / Relay Fault!
error_list.english_solution: Check contactor coil, contacts and fuse; replace contactor if necessary.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动软件运行故障!

error_list.english_solution: Reset or restart the drive; update software; contact technical support.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动用户自定义故障!

error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: User-Defined Fault!
error_list.english_solution: Handle as per OEM manual; usually VCL logic or parameter issue.

error_list.chinese_discription: 左侧行走驱动固件损坏/版本不匹配!

error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: Firmware Corrupted / Version Mismatch!
error_list.english_solution: Re-download compatible firmware; verify hardware and firmware versions match.

error_list.english_discription: The Left walk drive: EEPROM / NV Memory Error!
error_list.english_solution: Restore factory settings or reload parameters; replace controller if necessary.

error_list.english_solution: Inspect battery, fuses, main contactor and parameters; verify cables and terminals are tight.

error_list.chinese_discription: 右侧行走驱动预充电错误!

error_list.english_discription: The Right walk drive: Pre-charge Error!

error_list.english_discription: The Right walk drive: Over-current / Current Sensor Fault!

error_list.chinese_solution: 降低负载或改善散热;确认散热片,风扇,环境温度正常!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Controller Temperature Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Reduce load or improve cooling; verify heatsink, fan and ambient temperature are normal.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动电机温度异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电机温升,散热条件,热敏电阻;必要时停机冷却!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Motor Temperature Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check motor temperature rise, cooling conditions and thermistor; shut down for cooling if necessary.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动因温度降功率!
error_list.chinese_solution: 继续降功率运行或停机降温;检查散热/负载!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Power Derated due to Temperature!
error_list.english_solution: Continue derated operation or shut down to cool; inspect cooling and load.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动电机开路!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电机 U/V/W 相线连接;确认绕组,端子无断线!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Motor Open Circuit!
error_list.english_solution: Check motor U/V/W phase connections; confirm windings and terminals are not open.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动电机短路!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电机绕组,相线是否短路;排除外部短路点!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Motor Short Circuit!
error_list.english_solution: Check motor windings and phase short circuits; eliminate external short points.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动堵转/速度异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查电机是否卡滞,编码器及负载;重新标定速度/负载参数!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Motor Stall / Speed Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check motor jam, encoder and load; recalibrate speed/load parameters.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动电机类型/相位/极性错误!
error_list.chinese_solution: 重新进行电机自学习;核对电机铭牌,极性,相序!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Motor Type / Phase / Polarity Error!
error_list.english_solution: Re-run motor auto-tuning; verify nameplate, polarity and phase sequence.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动编码器信号丢失!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查编码器供电,接线,屏蔽;确认编码器完好!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Encoder Signal Lost!
error_list.english_solution: Check encoder supply, wiring and shielding; confirm encoder is intact.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动编码器反馈异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查编码器信号,连线,屏蔽;必要时更换编码器!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Encoder Feedback Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check encoder signal, wiring and shielding; replace encoder if necessary.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动消息/PDO超时!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查 CAN 网络连接,波特率,PDO 配置;确认电缆屏
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Message / PDO Timeout!
error_list.english_solution: Check CAN network connections, baud rate and PDO configuration; confirm cable shielding.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动通信总线异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查总线终端电阻,电缆,接头;排除干扰源!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Communication Bus Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check bus termination resistors, cables and connectors; eliminate interference sources.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动消息校验错误!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查 CAN 电缆,屏蔽,终端电阻;确认节点无故障!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Message Check Error!
error_list.english_solution: Check CAN cables, shielding and termination resistors; ensure nodes are fault-free.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动通信映射错误!
error_list.chinese_solution: 核对 PDO 映射表,节点 ID,报文格式;重新下载映射
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Communication Mapping Error!
error_list.english_solution: Verify PDO mapping, node ID and message format; reload mapping configuration.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动油门/模拟输入/原点/限位信号异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查油门,限位开关,原点开关及其接线;确认信号范围及参数
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Throttle / Analog / Home / Limit Signal Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Inspect throttle, limit and home switches and wiring; confirm signal range and parameters.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动制动信号/保护/STO信号异常!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查制动开关,STO 回路,接线;确认安全链正常!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Brake / Protection / STO Signal Abnormal!
error_list.english_solution: Check brake switch, STO circuit and wiring; confirm safety chain is normal.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动模拟量超限!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查模拟量输入上下限,接线,屏蔽;重新标定!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Analog Input Out of Range!
error_list.english_solution: Check analog input limits, wiring and shielding; recalibrate.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动接触器/继电器故障!
error_list.chinese_solution: 检查接触器线圈,触点,保险丝;必要时更换接触器!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Contactor / Relay Fault!
error_list.english_solution: Check contactor coil, contacts and fuse; replace contactor if necessary.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动软件运行故障!
error_list.chinese_solution: 复位或重启驱动器;更新软件;联系技术支持!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Software Fault!
error_list.english_solution: Reset or restart the drive; update software; contact technical support.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动用户自定义故障!
error_list.chinese_solution: 按 OEM手 册定义处理;通常是VCL逻辑或参数问题!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: User-Defined Fault!
error_list.english_solution: Handle as per OEM manual; usually VCL logic or parameter issue.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动固件损坏/版本不匹配!
error_list.chinese_solution: 重新下载兼容固件;确认硬件与固件版本匹配!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Firmware Corrupted / Version Mismatch!
error_list.english_solution: Re-download compatible firmware; verify hardware and firmware versions match.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动EEPROM/NV 存储器错误!
error_list.chinese_solution: 恢复出厂设置或重新下载参数;必要时更换控制器!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: EEPROM / NV Memory Error!
error_list.english_solution: Restore factory settings or reload parameters; replace controller if necessary.

error_list.chinese_discription: 扩展负载驱动参数超范围/冲突!
error_list.chinese_solution: 将参数调整至允许范围;检查冲突设置;重新标定!
error_list.english_discription: The Extend load drive: Parameter Out of Range / Conflict!
error_list.english_solution: Adjust parameters to allowed range; check conflicting settings; recalibrate.

error_list.chinese_discription: 串口通信失败，请检查！
单体电压低，请进行充电校准！
error_list.english_discription: Low individual voltage, please perform charging calibration!
error_list.english_solution: Low individual voltage, please perform charging calibration
